queries_run: COHR Coherent tariff Section 232 China export control 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：美國對半導體、關鍵礦物及衍生電子產品啟動 Section 232 調查，可能新增關稅；公司在美國與海外製造採購，自認可能比國際化程度低的企業更易受影響；並提及 AI／資料中心相關產品可能出現新出口管制。
findings.excerpt: In addition, the U.S. government has initiated investigations under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 to evaluate whether additional tariffs may be necessary on certain commodities, including semiconductors, critical minerals, and derivative electronics products, on national-security grounds

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：美國政府持續擴充實體清單，已對公司營收及銷售能力造成不利影響；若出口管制在產能與採購承諾後加嚴，可能需認列庫存與不可取消採購義務的鉅額費用。
findings.excerpt: The U.S. government may continue to add companies to its restricted entity list and/or technologies to its list of prohibited exports to specific countries, which have had and may in the future have an adverse effect on our revenue and our ability to sell our products.

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：2026-02-20 最高法院判 IEEPA 關稅無效；公司為進口記錄人，FY2026 Q4 認列退稅，金額不重大；公司稱全球製造佈局有一定緩解能力。
findings.excerpt: The amounts recorded were not material to the Company.

note: 僅1次搜尋，未找到 COHR 專屬的第三方關稅／實體清單報導；以一手 10-K 為主。
